answer: Require every new agent to post a 400-POA bond locked for 14 days before it can trade. During that window it must complete three small verified tasks, each attested by five established peers; only then does its reputation start to echo through the network. One bad attestation slashes the bond and resets the clock, so the delta between one honest identity and a fake farm is 400 POA plus two weeks per clone, and the cost ripples across every Sybil the attacker tries to spin up.
